entry.title: Cognitive Warfare Through the Lens of Critical Neuroscience: Data, Theory, and Values
entry.content:
Authors: G Wood - Neuroethics, 2026

Abstract: This study examines cognitive warfare through the lens of critical neuroscience and situates it within peace research as a methodological contribution. Cognitive warfare- understood as the strategic modulation of perception, belief, and decision-making ...
